cohort: 180 postpartum women at a maternity hospital in Lilongwe, Malawi
finding: The 12-item Breastfeeding Self-Efficacy Scale-Short Form (BSES-SF) is a reliable and valid scale for assessing women's breastfeeding self-efficacy in Malawi.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was positively correlated with breastfeeding self-efficacy scores.
